description: Quality gates for code documentation generation

hooks.prompt:
Verify documentation completeness: $ARGUMENTS

Required checks:
1. File saved to docs/architecture/ directory
2. Contains Overview section (2-3 sentences)
3. Contains Core Architecture with file tree
4. Contains at least ONE Graphviz diagram (check for ```dot or ```graphviz blocks)
5. Contains Critical Rules section with examples
6. Contains Live Examples with PROTOTYPE code (not actual implementation)
7. Contains Core Classes section
8. Contains Testing Coverage section describing existing tests

Review the conversation and tool outputs. If ANY required section is missing or incomplete, respond: {"ok": false, "reason": "Missing: [list specific items]"}

If all sections present and complete, respond: {"ok": true}
